Turnip Gen8 V39-patched — bundled upstream binary
================================================

Publisher: StevenMXZ
Release: https://github.com/StevenMXZ/Adreno-Tools-Drivers/releases/tag/v39
Original asset: Turnip_Gen8_V39_Patched.zip (asset 721176461)
SHA-256: bd457b30f195cf93a334b5302c221b1b5cb59c79c485935decf95d560a38c8a2

The original ZIP is bundled unchanged as driver.zip. Its meta.json names the
driver "Turnip Gen8 V39-patched". The embedded library reports Mesa
27.0.0-devel (git-2648b2059f). This is the patched Gen8 release, not the
unpatched Gen8, R2 or OneUI package from the same release.

Mesa source revision:
https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/tree/2648b2059f1a412d64a8700dbbb75bbb4a768b0e
Mesa license information at that revision is included as Mesa-license.rst.
Mesa is mostly MIT-licensed; individual files carry their own copyright and
SPDX notices. Mesa's upstream license texts and source notices are included
with this bundle. They cover source components, not a claim that every Mesa
component is linked into this driver.

Publisher build recipes and patch sources at the release tag:
https://github.com/StevenMXZ/Adreno-Tools-Drivers/tree/b3b32ad30e7d7b4bd897e678af064036eeb9df09
That repository provides GPL version 3 in its LICENSE; a verbatim copy is
included as LICENSE-Driver-Recipes-GPL-3.0.txt. Its recipes fetch Mesa main
unless a commit is provided. The release does not record a complete applied
patch/build manifest, so this project pins the released binary by hash rather
than claiming that the current recipes reproduce it byte for byte.

The binary was built with Android NDK r29 and contains C++ runtime code without
a separate libc++ dependency. LICENSE-LLVM.txt preserves the LLVM/libc++
license and exceptions. Other Android system libraries remain supplied by
the device, including libhardware, libsync and libnativewindow.

Compatibility metadata: meta.json says minApi 28; the ELF Android ABI note
says API 34, and strong C11-thread imports require LIBC_R (API 30). Device
support must be established by loading the driver and checking its Vulkan
identity/features. The driver exposes the Android Vulkan HAL HMI entry and
needs AdrenoTools integration; it is not a standalone libvulkan loader.

Sources and hashes are also recorded in provenance.json. No game support or
performance guarantee is implied by bundling this driver.
